verdict.rationale: Browserbase is API-first: the docs describe creating, controlling, and observing browser sessions programmatically, an official `@browserbasehq/sdk` reference, a Downloads API, and webhooks with SDK-managed endpoints. The llms.txt probe confirms a single-API-key model aimed at agents. missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec at the probed paths, and no independent hands-on corroboration of API usage.
